terms.gloss: to modify, to be added to (a word)
terms.grammar: passive of adjiciō, with the dative of the word modified
evidence: Prisc. p. 1003 P.: cujus significātiō verbīs adjicitur (Lewis & Short s.v. adverbium)
terms.comment: The adverb and the adjective are “added” to the word they qualify: Cui nōminī «bonus» adjicitur?, which noun does “bonus” modify? (Traupman 247); Cui dictiōnī adverbium adjicitur? (231). Modifying is adjectus (Traupman 247).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 231, 232, 244, 247, 346.
